what.title: What is Nova-Tweaks?
what.body1: Nova-Tweaks is a Windows optimization app for applying structured tweaks, inspecting system state, and keeping rollback paths available.
what.body2: The app focuses on controlled changes, clear risk labels, backups, diagnostics, and settings that persist between launches.

basics.title: Tweaks basics
basics.body1: Use the Tweaks tab to search, filter, inspect, and apply available tweak definitions.
basics.body2: Open the details panel before applying unfamiliar tweaks so you can review category, impact, risk, tags, and current status.

safety.title: Safety and risk labels
safety.body1: Risk labels indicate how sensitive a tweak is. High-risk or critical actions can require confirmation.
safety.body2: Restart warnings are shown for changes that may need a Windows restart before they are fully active.

backups.title: Backups and restore points
backups.body1: Backups preserve Nova configuration data before supported tweak actions. Choose a reliable local backup location.
backups.body2: System restore points, when available, are managed separately by Windows and should be used before broad system changes.

startup.title: Startup behavior
startup.body1: Startup settings control whether Nova-Tweaks starts with Windows and whether it opens minimized or stays in the tray.
startup.body2: Tray behavior keeps the app available in the background without showing the main window.

importExport.title: Importing and exporting settings
importExport.body1: Export settings to create a portable JSON settings file with a schema marker and version.
importExport.body2: Imported settings are validated before use. Unknown keys are ignored and missing values fall back to defaults.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.body1: If something behaves unexpectedly, export a diagnostic report and check the logs folder from Settings.
troubleshooting.body2: Diagnostic reports avoid unnecessary personal data and focus on app version, OS, settings, paths, and recent log hints.

support.title: Contact support
support.body1: Use the Contact Support card to open the Discord community or email support.
support.body2: Include a diagnostic report when reporting technical issues so support can inspect non-sensitive context quickly.
